description: Elections Commission - Declare that K. Vijayakumar as a Member of the Puthukkudyirupu P/S
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Puthukkdiyirupu Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member. The content specifically follows procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, involves the nomination process by a recognized political party, and results in the declaration of a new elected member. This falls directly under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections.
